title: Hardening, end-to-end tests and release checklist
agent_directive: This JSON is the complete task spec. First read docs/prompts/_standards.json once, then load the skills in `skills`. Create vercel.json (function maxDuration for generate-broadsheet and import-rosters, cron only if the stretch reminder was built), confirm runtime nodejs on all Server Actions, finalise .env.example, and make sure /dev/ui is not reachable in production.

Write docs/release-checklist.md: results of each command, Firebase production setup steps (project, authorized domains including the Vercel domain, deploy rules and indexes, seed with --prod), Vercel env vars, first-admin bootstrap, and known deferred items (email, grade classification, cross-category override, supervisor access to student contact).
acceptance: Checklist file lists each command with its pass/fail result
